verdict: GBP visibility dropped sharply across all three locations this week.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, Google Business Profile was the sole source of customer activity this period — paid campaigns remain paused with zero spend or leads generated. In the last seven days, GBP actions fell sharply at every location: -100% at Forte, -82% at Advance Grinding, and -66% at O'Hare Precision, pointing to a shared visibility issue rather than isolated incidents. The Web/SEO root cause fix and contact list pulls needed to restore that visibility are both being resolved now as the immediate priority. Once those blockers clear, GBP recovery work and outreach sequences can move forward, and paid campaigns are positioned to relaunch behind them.
